source_citation: Schott and McCreary (2001), The monsoon circulation of the Indian Ocean, Progress in Oceanography 51, 1–123, doi:10.1016/S0079-6611(01)00083-0.
source_locator: Section 5.1.5, printed pp. 63–65 / PDF indices 62–64; Figure 48 caption distinguishes August 1993 and January 1991 sections.
source_access: Original review PDF section 5.1.5 and Figure 48 caption read. Schott et al. (1994) publisher-indexed abstract read; direct full article retrieval failed. No figure, model curve or velocity field digitized.
scope: Two declared 77–83 E Sri Lanka regional seasonal reaches under the existing Monsoon Current name; no upstream/downstream whole-current endpoints determined.
layer: Near-surface regional reference context; historical local profiles are shallow and depth dependent. Subsurface counterflows and equatorial jets remain separate.
time_convention: Boreal source labels, June–September SMC and November–February NMC. Transition geometry is missing; reported persistence beyond February is not forced into the nominal winter calendar.

local_section_context.source_reported_layer_context: Review describes a shallow summer flow and roughly 120 m January 1991 winter penetration locally; neither fixes an axis depth across the route.

supporting_sources.citation: Schott, Reppin, Fischer and Quadfasel (1994), Currents and transports of the Monsoon Current south of Sri Lanka.
supporting_sources.locator: Publisher-indexed abstract; direct full article unavailable.
supporting_sources.supports: Local mooring/ship observations distinguish shallow surface flow, seasonal reversal and nearby opposite flow. Transport integration support is not a longitudinal route or complete transverse width.

remaining_gates: Review seasonal velocity axes, fixed regional gates and connecting coordinates.
